pages.title: Patch-Clamp Rig
pages.text: A glass pipette a micrometre across, pressed to a membrane under a microscope, reading the voltage across it.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the ion concentrations outside and inside. The voltage across the membrane is E = (RT/zF) ln(c_out/c_in) and must land in the recipe's window. Too great a difference and the membrane bursts from osmosis.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Ion Channel Membrane, Lipid Bilayer, Living Cell.
